■ Stage Direction
1 second of silence at the start

Hah, whew... T-Trainer.
My time just now was faster than last time, wasn't it...!

I'm glad. Off I go, then. Are you heading back ahead of me, Trainer?
Please don't worry about me—
Haaaaaaah!!
(...Even now, looking back on that moment, it feels like a miracle.)

Workouts that would be perfectly reasonable for an average Umamusume
can sometimes be an unbearable burden for K.S. Miracle.

I'm so happy... Trainer.
I promise I'll repay this kindness out on the track!
Hah, hah, hah...

It's not that she "can't stop"—she "won't stop."
Do you truly understand how terrifying that is?

(I found someone else... I want to say thank you to.
—Ah, what an incredible...)

...You don't have to include yourself in K.S. Miracle's wish.
If she can't stop running, then at the very least...

(A Trainer who would take me on...
even after knowing what my body is like...)

...Trainer.
...All right. I'm in your hands!
"I want... to run alongside you."

A gentle smile, innocent as a child's.
Her words and that smile made me realize something.
(How truly fortunate I am. I'm so blessed.)

(...I have nothing I can give you in return right now.
So please, wait for me. One day, I will definitely deliver it to you.)
"...I want to run alongside you."
She will surely push herself to train even harder where no one can see.

Had I ended up included among those she wants to repay?
It certainly wasn't a bad thing, but still...

May I do one more lap?
I want to sharpen this feeling while it's fresh.

I knew it...! I could feel the difference.
It was completely unlike when I was training on my own.

Some time has passed since I became K.S. Miracle's Trainer.
Our training has been progressing smoothly.
...Y-Yes!

I wanted to take on every other burden for her.
If only she could just lean on me, and let herself be spoiled—

(Along with wanting to tell everyone,
"I'm all right," and "Thank you"—)

(Even so, I was desperate to find one...
So when you praised my running, I was overjoyed.)

Ah... it's already time to finish, isn't it?
But... um, Trainer.

(—I never once gave up. But somewhere deep down...
I thought I might never be able to find one.)

...I know. I've come to understand that.
And that is precisely why I am standing here as her Trainer right now.

To be honest, there are times when I want to tell her to stop.
But if I were to do that...

That girl's passion for running is far too intense.
Even if the strain pushes her into the danger zone... she won't slow down for a second.

K.S. Miracle runs with everything she has to grant her wish.
No matter what toll it might take on her own body.
Hah, hah, hah...!

(Yet you, Trainer...
are always so vigilant and on edge for my sake, aren't you?)
(Even if it all started out of sheer impatience and momentum...)
(These feelings that I want to convey to you and you alone.)
